caseName: Boca Grande Club, Inc. v. Florida Power & Light Co.
caseNameFull: Boca Grande Club, Inc. v. Florida Power & Light Co., Inc.

opinions.text: C. A. 11th Cir. Certiorari granted. Brief of petitioner is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Tuesday, November 9, 1993. Brief of respondent is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Tuesday, December 7, 1993. A reply brief, if any, is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Tuesday, December 21, 1993. This Court’s Rule 29 does not apply.
